subject: English
stimulus: (a) Why he came here ⎯⎯. (b) He was so angry that ⎯⎯. (c) Would you mind ⎯⎯. (d) ⎯⎯ I would solve the problem. (e) He confirmed that ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Why he came here is not known to us. (b) He was so angry that he even did not talk to me. (c) Would you mind taking a cup of tea? (d) If I had the ability, I would solve the problem. (e) He confirmed that he would join the event.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Jhenaidah Cadet College, Jhenaidah (Test Paper Cadet 2nd) 2023
